responsibility: Translator for BRIG `cvt` conversion instructions, including the frontend’s most detailed scalar conversion semantics. It interprets conversion source and destination types separately from register storage types, applies fp16 widening/narrowing and flush-to-zero handling, implements BRIG `b1` zero-test behavior, performs integer sign/zero extension rules, selects saturating float-to-int builtins when required, and writes the final value back using the destination register’s storage representation.
